data.one_liner: Enables onWillPop callbacks on Cupertino page transitions and improves gesture feedback.
data.what_it_does: Provides a CustomWillPopScope widget that allows developers to handle back navigation and 'onWillPop' callbacks during Cupertino page transitions. It also improves visual feedback for rejected swipe-to-go-back gestures across platforms.
use_when: You need 'onWillPop' functionality on Cupertino page transitions.
You want to intercept back gestures or hardware back button presses to prevent accidental data loss.
You need to restrict swipe-to-return behavior on specific screens.
avoid_when: You are using the standard WillPopScope or PopScope without needing Cupertino-specific page transition adjustments.
strengths: Enables back interception on Cupertino transitions.
Improves visual feedback for rejected swipe-to-go-back gestures.
Supports customizable onWillPop and onPopAction callbacks.
weaknesses: Requires careful state management for the 'canReturn' flag.
The 'onWillPop' property should not be changed once set.
data.minimal_example:
CustomWillPopScope(
  canReturn: _canReturn,
  onWillPop: _onWillPop,
  onPopAction: _onPopAction,
  child: Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(title: Text('Second Screen')),
    body: Center(child: Text('Content')),),
)
